Maria: heads up — noticed a big jump in traces/sec for eu-west around 03:10 UTC, Grafana SLO burn rate went noisy and GPU charge for the region spiked :eyes:
Ashok: :thinking: is this correlation or causation? Prometheus alert name?
Maria: alert: trace_ingest_rate_high_eu_west, fired at 03:11. Prometheus shows ~6x normal spans/sec for runtime pods.
Devon: any deploys around then? deploy-bot: deployment redwood-runtime/eu-west v3.12.1 rolled at 03:05 UTC (canary->all).
Maria: good catch. logs show a flood of very small spans from inference runtime, many repeat parentless spans. sample of logs: `2026-02-14T03:11:22Z runtime[pod-7]: span created: model_infer.start id=... parent_id=null traceflags=01`
SRE Sam: that parentless pattern + parentless traceflags suggests SDK sampling is turning on for downstream fragments. Could be a region SDK config defaulting to AlwaysOnSampler?
Ashok: iirc we patched the OTEL SDK defaults in the eu-west helm values to include `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on` for debugging last month, maybe it leaked to prod via values inheritance.
Devon: checking helm history: `helm get values redwood-runtime -n redwood-eu-west --revision 7` shows `tracing.sampler: "always_on"` in the values. That revision was applied as part of the canary promotion.
Maria: which would explain increased spans and billing, but why are these parentless? should have propagated traceparent header.
SRE Sam: gateway logs show `X-Otel-Sampled: 0` on some requests but runtime spans created with traceflags=01. Sounds like header mapping mismatch between our ingress gateway and runtime SDK. Maybe header names normalized (lowercase vs canonical) and our proxy rewrites `traceparent` -> `x-traceparent` during forwarding.
Devon: grepping nginx proxy: `grep -R "traceparent" /etc/nginx/conf.d` — found `proxy_set_header traceparent $http_traceparent;` we then added a sidecar that rewrites headers to `x-traceparent` for legacy clients.
Ashok: so SDK is ignoring `x-traceparent` and starting fresh traces, while sampler is always_on -> duplicates.
Maria: impact: SLO dashboards show apparent higher request trace coverage, alert noise, and our OTLP exporter bills token/instrumentation costs and causes GPU scheduling chatter?
SRE Sam: GPU scheduling cost spike explanation: increased spans increase OTLP ingestion and async exporters, pushing CPU/IO, autoscaler interpreted backlog as qps increase and spun extra replica groups with GPU attached (bad).
Devon: mitigation options: 1) revert sampler to parentbased_traceidratio (quick) 2) make gateway forward canonical `traceparent` header 3) patch SDK to accept `x-traceparent` fallback. Which is least risky?
Ashok: revert sampler to previous env `parentbased_traceidratio` in values and roll; that prevents AlwaysOn from creating new spans for forwarded requests. Doable in next 5-10m if we cut canary.
Maria: please do rollback canary -> stop the roll. Also add a temporary alert mute for `trace_ingest_rate_high_eu_west` and annotate incident in pager duty. ops-bot: mute applied for 30m for alert `trace_ingest_rate_high_eu_west` in eu-west by Maria.
ops-bot: NOTE: alert mute created by Maria until 03:41 UTC.
Devon: creating PR to change gateway header rewrite to preserve `traceparent` and to add fallback in SDK: PR #2489.
SRE Sam: after rollback we should run a quick sampling audit: count parentless spans by service over last hour: `sum by(service) (increase(otel_spans_created_total{region="eu-west"}[1h])) - sum by(service) (increase(otel_spans_with_parent_total{region="eu-west"}[1h]))`
Ashok: rollback applied, canary stopped at 03:18 UTC. Monitoring: otel traces/sec dropping to normal by 03:24. GPU autoscaler scaled down by 03:38.
Maria: thanks. followups: - add integration test for header mappings in gateway e2e - document sampler overrides per-region in infra runbook - alert: change threshold and add runbook link.
Devon: added TODOs to PR #2489 and created infra ticket INF-523.
Maria: closing thread once we confirm stable for 1h. current status: stable, alert muted, rollback done. :white_check_mark:
